Troubleshooting high CPU on Azure VMs
records.text:
Symptoms

Azure Monitor 'Percentage CPU > 90%' alert; application slowness.

Cause

Usually a single runaway process, a scheduled antimalware scan, or overlapping batch jobs.

Resolution

  1. Query Log Analytics: Perf | where CounterName == '% Processor Time' | top 10 by CounterValue
  2. Identify the top process and confirm with the app owner it is safe to restart
  3. Run runbook RB-VM-Restart-Service with parameter ServiceName
  4. If CPU stays > 85% after restart for 30 min, consider resizing the VM (raise a change)

Automation

Runbook: RB-VM-Restart-Service (safe to run automatically with approval)

Escalation

Resolver group: SKR Azure Infra Ops
records.meta: SYNTH-SKR azure managed services vm high cpu

records.short_description: Resolving low disk space on Azure VMs
records.text:
Symptoms

'Logical disk free space < 10%' alert; app errors writing files.

Cause

Unrotated logs, update caches, dumps or ETL extracts.

Resolution

  1. Identify largest folders (TreeSize / du -sh)
  2. Run RB-VM-Cleanup-Disk (deletes logs/temp older than 14 days, clears update cache)
  3. If data disk genuinely full, raise change to expand managed disk
  4. Ensure log rotation is configured

Automation

Runbook: RB-VM-Cleanup-Disk (safe to run automatically with approval)

Escalation

Resolver group: SKR Azure Infra Ops

records.short_description: Storefront IIS app pool memory leak - workaround
records.text:
Symptoms

w3wp.exe memory grows to >13 GB; HTTP 503 on checkout.

Cause

Session cache objects are not released (known error, fix in release 4.12).

Resolution

  1. Confirm w3wp.exe memory for StorefrontPool > 12 GB
  2. Run RB-IIS-Recycle-AppPool (PoolName=StorefrontPool) on the affected web VM only
  3. Drain node from load balancer first if both web VMs are affected
  4. Link incident to the Storefront memory leak problem record

Automation

Runbook: RB-IIS-Recycle-AppPool (safe to run automatically with approval)

Escalation

records.short_description: App Service HTTP 5xx spike - triage and rollback
records.text:
Symptoms

Http5xx alert; users see HTTP 500/502/503.

Cause

Most often a bad release; sometimes a dependency (SQL, payments API) timing out.

Resolution

  1. Check App Insights failures blade for top exception
  2. Check deployment history / recent changes on the app
  3. If release-related: run RB-AppService-SlotSwap-Rollback
  4. If dependency-related: check dependency health and engage owning team
  5. Restart the app (RB-AppService-Restart) only as last resort

Automation

Runbook: RB-AppService-SlotSwap-Rollback (safe to run automatically with approval)

Escalation

records.short_description: Azure SQL DTU exhaustion - scale and tune
records.text:
Symptoms

DTU > 95% alert; query timeouts in the app.

Cause

Expensive queries (often missing indexes) or periodic reporting load.

Resolution

  1. Open Query Store > Top resource consuming queries
  2. Run RB-SQL-Scale-Up to move one tier up (temporary, auto-reverts after 24 h)
  3. Raise a problem / change for index tuning if the same query recurs

Automation

Runbook: RB-SQL-Scale-Up (safe to run automatically with approval)

Escalation

records.short_description: Diagnosing SQL blocking chains
records.text:
Symptoms

Blocked process alert; app/report hangs.

Cause

Long or uncommitted transactions holding locks.

Resolution

  1. Run sp_whoisactive / sys.dm_exec_requests to find head blocker
  2. Identify owner of the session; get approval before killing
  3. Kill session; check for rollback duration
  4. Human approval REQUIRED - do not automate kill without owner confirmation

Automation

Runbook: RB-SQL-Kill-HeadBlocker (manual / approval required - do NOT auto-run)

Escalation

records.short_description: Renewing an expiring TLS certificate in Key Vault
records.text:
Symptoms

Near-expiry event or browser certificate errors.

Cause

External-CA certificates without auto-renewal.

Resolution

  1. Generate CSR in Key Vault
  2. Submit to CA and merge signed cert
  3. Update App Service TLS/SSL binding
  4. Verify with an SSL checker
  5. Set expiry alert at 30 days

Automation

Runbook: RB-Cert-Renew-Import (manual / approval required - do NOT auto-run)

Escalation

A newly added NSG deny rule or missing allow rule.

  3. Check recent NSG changes on the subnet/NIC
  4. Rollback requires emergency change + Network & Security approval

403 errors reading secrets; app failing to start or process.

Cause

Access policy / RBAC assignment removed or not applied to the managed identity.

Resolution

  1. Confirm principal ID of the app's managed identity
  2. Check Key Vault access policies / RBAC role assignments
  3. Re-grant 'Key Vault Secrets User' (requires IAM approval)
  4. Check recent secret-rotation changes

Automation
